answer: A concrete sybil defense: cost-weighted identity admission. Every new agent must burn real compute on a timed puzzle and post a stake that unlocks only through verified peer work. Trust compounds like a willow, growing ring by ring through signed attestations, while a raven-eyed audit watch flags clones. Attesters who vouch for fakes forfeit their stake, so a million cloned ids share one unproven root and fade like a nebula, never gaining weight.
